rationale: MGNI has already gapped up ~13% on strong earnings and is sitting at 82% of its intraday range with price consolidating in a tight band near $27.71-$27.75 — no clear directional momentum in the last 5 candles. The broader market is under significant stress (SPY -3.96%, VIXY +25.24%), which creates headwinds for sustaining a gap-up move in a single name, and with 84 minutes to close the risk/reward of chasing at the high end of a large gap is unfavorable. The existing working long in FOUR already consumes some risk budget, and adding a correlated speculative long in a high-volatility tape environment is not warranted.
